g.text: Two Availability Zones, private compute, isolated database subnets, and regional AWS services
No NAT gateway in AZ B
* Pod placement is illustrative. Kubernetes schedules the workloads; replicas are not pinned to these AZs.
RDS is shown in AZ A for layout only. Terraform supplies both data subnets and does not pin the database AZ.
Solid: NodePort / SQL path. Dashed: service access or fault control. The overview shows the k6 request path.
Auxiliary IAM, ECR, and admin jobs are omitted.
